question: True or false: tuning GPT-4 into a chat assistant made its confidence a worse guide to whether it was right?
answer: True. On a multiple-choice test, OpenAI found the raw pre-trained model well calibrated: its answers given 70% probability were right about 70% of the time. After training it into a helpful assistant, confidence and accuracy matched far less well. The assistant people talk to knows less about its own reliability.
move: Improving how something performs can damage how well it knows itself.
trap: Assuming the tuning that makes answers better improves every measure.
